'''Chia-Hsiung Tze''' (often H.C. Tze) is a professor emeritus at [[Virginia Tech]].<ref>{{cite web
 |title        = Chia Tze
 |url          = http://www.phys.vt.edu/people/tze.html
 |publisher    = [[Virginia Tech]]
 |accessdate   = 2010-01-04
 |archive-url  = https://web.archive.org/web/20081010181207/http://www.phys.vt.edu/people/tze.html
 |archive-date = 2008-10-10
 |url-status     = dead
}}</ref> He is a [[theoretical physics|theoretical]] [[particle physicist]] focusing on [[group theory]], [[string theory]], [[supersymmetry]], [[octonions]] and other topics in theoretical physics.

He was a colleague of the [[Feza Gürsey]].
